messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: service=redwood-api env=prod commit=v1.12.0 tag=release/2026-03-22 migrations=[AddSearchIndexes, NormalizeUserEmails] start_time=2026-03-22T14:07:01Z :rocket:
chris: ack. which migration runs first? any long locks expected?
sam: AddSearchIndexes runs first, it builds a few indexes concurrently but still may take ~2-5m on large tables. NormalizeUserEmails is a small data migration.
deploy-bot: Migration job started: job_id=job-4821 step=AddSearchIndexes pid=9345
infra-bot: Noted. Autoscaling on DB replicas enabled for the next 20m.
sam: getting a tail of the db logs, one worker spiked with deadlock warnings, seeing 50% slowdown on writes.
sam: ```
ERROR: canceling statement due to conflict with recovery
DETAIL: User query conflict with replication slot
CONTEXT: SQL statement "CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_search_terms ON posts USING gin(to_tsvector('english', content))"
```
maya: hmm, that's the index create. Can we switch to CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY with lower maintenance? it's already concurrent but maybe we hit long running transactions. Any active transactions?
chris: any quick mitigation? pause index build and continue with NormalizeUserEmails?
sam: deploy-bot reports AddSearchIndexes failed: job_id=job-4821 status=failed error="canceling statement due to conflict"
deploy-bot: Rolling back subsequent migration steps: skipping NormalizeUserEmails until issue resolved. Marking deploy as paused.
lei: Given failure in prod index build and write slowdown, I recommend aborting this release and rolling back so we don't risk customer writes. We can reattempt index build during a low-traffic window with a more conservative plan.
maya: +1. Also capture the migration input set and pin schema_migration table to current hash so re-run won't run half-applied changes.
chris: agree. rollback? what does rollback mean for the index that partially started?
sam: partial concurrent index create was canceled, no index exists. No down migration needed for that step; NormalizeUserEmails didn't run.
deploy-bot: Initiating release rollback: target=prod commit=v1.12.0 action=rollback reason="migration failure" start=2026-03-22T14:09:58Z
deploy-bot: Rollback complete: services rolled back to commit=v1.11.9 tag=stable/2026-03-20 duration=00:02:12
infra-bot: DB replicas marked healthy. Clearing autoscale override.
maya: filing follow-up: plan for reattempt: run index create during 02:00-04:00 UTC with smaller batch sizes, add monitoring alert on index build locks.
chris: also add a migration pre-check job that detects long-running txns and blocks index creation if threshold exceeded. Ticket in Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-3421
sam: copying logs/snippets to the incident thread. Will create a replay run in staging with the same dataset.
deploy-bot: Deploy status: aborted migrations=[AddSearchIndexes] rolled_back=true normalized_migrations_skipped=true rollback_complete=true
chris: thanks everyone. will follow up on re-schedule. :thumbsup:
